newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Treasury sees solid retail activity.
newsitem.headline: Australian Treasury sees solid retail activity.

text.p: A senior Australian Treasury official on Tuesday forecast solid retail activity.

"The most accurate description is to look at the ABS (Australian Bureau of Statistics) retail trade data, which shows that retail has grown by 2.2 percent in real terms in the first three months of '97 and that the pace of activity looks like it's going to remain reasonably solid, in line with the expected growth in income," Treasury forecaster Martin Parkinson told a Senate committee.

"But I think reasonably solid growth in the region of three-quarters of a percent, a percent quarter on average over the next year is the sort of numbers you'd be looking at (for private consumption)," he said.
